overview: The Council received an update on the Medford Public Library construction and fundraising, and discussed criteria for denying 5G antenna installations. Members also requested legal and financial reports regarding domestic partnerships and five-year revenue projections for federal relief planning.

items.title: Library Update
items.summary: Library Director Barbara Kerr and Councilor Caraviello reported that the new library building is expected to open in September 2021, with the Foundation raising over $5.4 million toward the project.

items.title: Congratulating Bill Boyd
items.summary: Approved a resolution and Senate citation congratulating Medford native Bill Boyd on his election to the New Hampshire State House of Representatives.

items.title: Verizon 5G Rollout Discussion
items.summary: Councilor Marks detailed how resident testimony regarding aesthetics and proximity led to the first denial of a 5G antenna application by the Ad Hoc Small Cell Committee.

items.title: Domestic Partnership Study
items.summary: Approved a request for the City Clerk and City Solicitor to study the legal steps and definitions required to establish domestic partnerships in Medford.

items.title: Revenue Projections and ARPA Funds
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide five-year revenue projections and a breakdown of spending restrictions for American Rescue Plan Act funds.

items.title: Public Participation and Records
items.summary: The Council addressed constituent inquiries regarding a missing POW flag and reports of an anti-Asian attack before tabling the meeting records for one week.
